sql: SELECT COUNT(customer_id) AS customer_count FROM marts.dim_customers LIMIT 1000
SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM marts.dim_customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY customer_count DESC, country LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue = TRUE AND order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date <= CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000
SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS INT) AS year, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1000

SELECT order_month, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue AND order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month LIMIT 1000

SELECT c.company_name, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM marts.fct_orders AS o JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.company_name LIMIT 5

SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE o.is_revenue GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS aov_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT p.category, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(l.net_amount - l.cogs) / NULLIF(SUM(l.net_amount), 0), 2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category LIMIT 1000

SELECT r.region, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders AS o JOIN marts.dim_sales_reps AS r ON r.sales_rep_id = o.sales_rep_id WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY revenue_2025 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_without_completed_order FROM marts.dim_customers WHERE first_order_date IS NULL LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_products FROM marts.dim_products WHERE is_active LIMIT 1000

SELECT p.product_id, p.sku, p.product_name, SUM(l.quantity) AS units_sold FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.product_id, p.sku, p.product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES
SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE p.method = 'card') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS card_payment_pct FROM marts.fct_payments AS p LIMIT 1000

SELECT p.method, ROUND(CAST(AVG(p.paid_at - o.order_date) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_days_to_pay FROM marts.fct_payments AS p JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = p.order_id GROUP BY p.method ORDER BY p.method LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS discounted_orders FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.discount_amount > 0 LIMIT 1000

SELECT c.segment, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue FROM marts.fct_orders AS o JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.created_at) AS INT) AS created_year, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM marts.dim_customers AS c GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.created_at) AS INT) ORDER BY created_year LIMIT 1000

SELECT order_month, COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue AND order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY completed_orders DESC, order_month FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE o.status = 'returned') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS returned_pct FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.net_revenue), 0), 2) AS net_revenue_eur FROM marts.fct_orders AS o JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.is_revenue AND c.country = 'DE' AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.shipping_fee), 0), 2) AS shipping_fees_eur FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_orders FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE status = 'open' LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT o.customer_id FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING SUM(o.net_revenue) > 50000) AS c LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(o.item_count) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_items_per_order FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.discount_amount), 2) AS discount_2025_eur FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(l.net_amount), 0), 2) AS discontinued_net_revenue FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE o.is_revenue AND p.is_active = FALSE LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(o.net_revenue) FILTER(WHERE o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)) - SUM(o.net_revenue) FILTER(WHERE o.order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE))) / NULLIF(SUM(o.net_revenue) FILTER(WHERE o.order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)), 0), 2) AS revenue_growth_pct FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000
SELECT region, COUNT(sales_rep_id) AS sales_rep_count FROM marts.dim_sales_reps GROUP BY region ORDER BY sales_rep_count DESC, region LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(*) AS churned_customers FROM (SELECT o.customer_id FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE o.order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)) > 0 AND COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)) = 0) AS c LIMIT 1000

SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount - l.cogs), 2) AS gross_margin_eur FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY SUM(l.net_amount - l.cogs) DESC, p.product_id LIMIT 3

SELECT ROUND(CAST((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.net_revenue)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS median_net_order_value FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT p.method, COUNT(*) AS payment_count, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM marts.fct_payments AS p WHERE p.paid_at >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND p.paid_at < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.method ORDER BY p.method LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE sales_rep_id = 3 AND order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM marts.fct_orders AS o JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.is_revenue AND c.segment = 'enterprise' AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1000
SELECT customer_id, first_order_date FROM marts.dim_customers WHERE customer_id = 42 LIMIT 1000

WITH customer_revenue AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(o.net_revenue) AS revenue FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.customer_id), ranked AS (SELECT revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC, customer_id) AS rn FROM customer_revenue) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(revenue) FILTER(WHERE rn <= 10) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0), 2) AS top10_revenue_pct FROM ranked LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id), 0), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_customer_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.product_id) AS distinct_products FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'FR' AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

WITH yearly AS (SELECT o.customer_id, COALESCE(SUM(o.net_revenue) FILTER(WHERE o.order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)), 0) AS rev_2024, COALESCE(SUM(o.net_revenue) FILTER(WHERE o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)), 0) AS rev_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM yearly WHERE rev_2024 > 0 AND rev_2025 < 0.5 * rev_2024 LIMIT 1000

WITH per_customer AS (SELECT o.customer_id, BOOL_OR(o.order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)) AS in_2024, BOOL_OR(o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)) AS in_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE in_2025) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS retention_pct FROM per_customer WHERE in_2024 LIMIT 1000

WITH monthly AS (SELECT order_month, SUM(net_revenue) AS revenue FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue AND order_date >= CAST('2024-12-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY order_month), growth AS (SELECT order_month, ROUND(100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY order_month)) / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY order_month), 0), 2) AS mom_growth_pct FROM monthly) SELECT order_month, mom_growth_pct FROM growth WHERE order_month >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) ORDER BY order_month LIMIT 1000

SELECT p.category, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(l.net_amount) FILTER(WHERE o.order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)), 0), 2) AS revenue_2024, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(l.net_amount) FILTER(WHERE o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)), 0), 2) AS revenue_2025, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(l.net_amount) FILTER(WHERE o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(l.net_amount) FILTER(WHERE o.order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)), 0), 2) AS revenue_increase FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE o.is_revenue GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue_increase DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(l.net_amount) FILTER(WHERE l.discount_pct > 0) / NULLIF(SUM(l.net_amount), 0), 2) AS discounted_revenue_share_pct FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(p.payment_id) AS late_payments FROM marts.fct_payments AS p JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE p.method = 'invoice' AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND p.paid_at - o.order_date > 30 LIMIT 1000

SELECT o.sales_rep_id, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.sales_rep_id ORDER BY revenue DESC, o.sales_rep_id LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(c.customer_id) AS new_customers_2025 FROM marts.dim_customers AS c WHERE c.first_order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND c.first_order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

WITH gaps AS (SELECT o.order_date - LAG(o.order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_date, o.order_id) AS days_between FROM marts.fct_orders AS o JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.is_revenue AND c.segment = 'enterprise') SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(days_between) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_days_between_orders FROM gaps WHERE days_between IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(o.gross_margin) / NULLIF(SUM(o.net_revenue), 0), 2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000
